description: This file contains function prototype for 'cbsearch', macro guards, includes, and licensing information related to the AMR speech codec, specifically for the 'cbsearch' function used in speech encoding.

methods.name: cbsearch
methods.description: Performs a search for the best match in the adaptive multi-rate speech codec, taking target vector, impulse response, pitch parameters, residuals, and other parameters as input, and outputs the innovative codebook and filtered excitation.
